anomalies.description: A person fires a handgun, producing a bright muzzle flash and visible sparks; the gun is held in a two-handed grip and aimed forward.; A bright muzzle flash and shower of sparks erupt from a firearm being discharged, indicating active shooting.

A man is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible in frame f6 (11.0s), indicating active discharge.; A person is seen aiming and firing a handgun toward the left; muzzle flash is visible in the dim environment.

A violent impact/explosion occurs on the floor, generating a cloud of debris and smoke; frames f7–f11 show the expanding blast and scattered fragments consistent with an explosive event (e.g., bullet impact on brittle surface or small detonation).

A projectile (likely a bullet) impacts a surface, causing a visible burst of debris and smoke; the trajectory and impact effects are consistent with gunfire.; A bullet hole appears on a dark panel next to the man in frame f12 (14.0s), and by f13 (14.5s) the hole is clearly visible with surrounding damage, indicating a recent gunshot impact.
A man is shown reacting immediately after a gunshot: his mouth is wide open in a yell/scream, and a fresh bullet hole with smoke/debris is visible on the wall beside him, indicating recent impact.
The same man repeats the yelling reaction with an open mouth, suggesting a second shot or sustained gunfire; the bullet hole remains visible, and his posture indicates ongoing threat.
A handgun is pointed directly at a woman's head in a close-up shot, indicating an imminent or ongoing shooting threat.

The man appears to be restraining or grappling with another person (partially obscured) while holding a firearm; physical contact and struggle are suggested by body positioning and proximity in frames f5–f10.
A bald man is crouched, holding a handgun with both hands and aiming it forward; muzzle flash is visible in frames f12–f15, indicating active firing.

A man is crouched, holding a handgun with both hands, aiming forward in a tense posture; muzzle flash or bright reflection is visible near the barrel in frames f4–f7, consistent with firing or imminent discharge.
